messages:
maria: quick check — we're onboarding the analytics namespace and need a service account that can put objects to the s3 bucket. can someone glance at the k8s manifest i'm about to apply?
jonathan: sure, drop it here. are we using the aws-iam annotation approach (role per-sa) or mounting a secret?
kai: prefer the role annotation so we don't manage long-lived creds. just confirm the cluster oidc provider is set up for the account.
maria: manifest below; i'm adding it to the analytics overlay in kustomize. wondering if the annotation key is correct.
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: analytics-uploader
  namespace: analytics
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-analytics-uploader-role
```
maria: terraform side — we created the role with a trust policy that references the OIDC: `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` and the condition on `sub` to `system:serviceaccount:analytics:analytics-uploader`.
jonathan: annotation looks right. run `kubectl get sa analytics-uploader -n analytics -o yaml` after apply to verify the annotation shows up. also check `kubectl describe pod` to confirm projected token mount is present.
kai: small gotcha — the IAM role's trust `Condition.StringEquals` must use the exact OIDC issuer host (without https) + `:sub`. our terraform module expects `oidc_provider_arn` and builds the provider thumbprint.
infra-bot: terraform plan for module/aws-iam-role (redwood-analytics-uploader) succeeded — no drift. <link to ci plan> :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. one more question — the kube manifest currently doesn't request any automountServiceAccountToken changes. do we need to set `automountServiceAccountToken: true` explicitly?
johnathan: default is true, but on some pods we set it false. for the uploader pod we want mounted projection so keep default or explicitly true if you want to be explicit.
kai: and ensure pods run with `serviceAccountName: analytics-uploader` in the Deployment. also check pod securitypolicy/psp/psa doesn't block projected tokens.
maria: noted. i'm also adding an ingress for a sidecar job that actually does the upload; i'll ping when i push the PR.
jonathan: lmk when PR is up, i'll review the kustomize overlay + tf change.
kai: if you want, i can pre-check the IAM policy — policy should be scoped to `s3:PutObject` + prefix `analytics/uploads/*`.
maria: perfect. i'll scope it and push. thanks all :pray:
jonathan: quick command list for verification after apply:
- `kubectl get sa analytics-uploader -n analytics -o yaml`
- `kubectl get deploy analytics-uploader -n analytics -o yaml`
- `kubectl describe pod <pod> -n analytics | grep -A3 "Projected"`
- `aws sts get-caller-identity --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-analytics-uploader-role --role-session-name debug`
maria: added to PR, tagging @jonathan for review. PR: <link>
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for analytics overlay (staging) — build #452 started.
maria: thanks infra-bot. i'll verify once staging is green.
